metadata.description: Claude Code skills by Khairold Safri.

plugins.name: khairold
plugins.description: Khairold's skills. dot-plan: plan, run, gate, audit and close an unattended multi-phase agent build kept in .plan/, looping until an audit round comes back dry. agent-guides: per-folder guides, a short root guide, one place per fact, kept true by tests. codebase-audit: audit a codebase by lens before a refactor, fold the findings into axes of work, re-audit after a build until dry, or sweep for one recurring bug class. chrome-intercept-mock: drive a logged-in Chrome over DevTools, capture a page's API calls, rewrite a response and screenshot how the real UI renders it, to tell a frontend bug from a backend one. design-loop: improve a deck, page or screen in rounds with contextless reviewers on orchestrator-picked axes, until dry. cockpit: a mod for watching a dot-plan run from a second session (/cockpit).
